newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint firms against dollar in static mkt.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint firms against dollar in static mkt.

text.p: Hungary's forint firmed against the dollar in quiet morning trade on Monday, dealers said.
At 0835 GMT, the forint stood at 155.50/53 against the U.S. unit as the market barely began to gear up for the week.
"Very little is happening at the moment," said Peter Piros of Europai Kereskedelmi Bank.
The forint was expected to follow dollar/mark as dealers did not foresee any domestic market-moving factors.
